- I opened `src/tests/dm_tests.ml` and checked the end of the file.

The issue: a dangling semicolon at the end of the last test’s body. On line 147 you end the expression with `;`, and there’s no following expression (line 148 is blank). In OCaml, `e1; e2` requires a second expression. Remove the trailing `;` or add `()` after it.

Example fix:
- Change:
  - `[%test_eq: bool] (Option.is_none (DocumentManager.Internal.observe_id st)) true;`
- To either:
  - `[%test_eq: bool] (Option.is_none (DocumentManager.Internal.observe_id st)) true`
  - or `[%test_eq: bool] (Option.is_none (DocumentManager.Internal.observe_id st)) true; ()`

- Adjusting this resolves the dune parse error at the end of the file.
